name: Sheep's milk
notes: fresh sheep's milk quart sold by a farm (sold out at capture)

name: Evaporated and condensed milk
definition: milk with part of its water removed, unsweetened (evaporated) or sweetened (condensed), sold tinned or tubed.
notes: Carnation evaporated milk tin and sweetened condensed milk tin both listed

name: Dulce de leche
definition: sweetened milk cooked down to a thick caramel-like milk spread.
notes: Carnation Dulce de Leche Caramel bottle 450g listed as its own product

name: Whipping cream
definition: cream of a fat content that whips.
notes: whipping cream listed with Emborg, Cowhead, Everwhip; Sainsbury's British Whipping Fresh Cream

name: Single (light) cream
definition: pouring cream of lower fat content that does not whip.
notes: Sainsbury's British Single Fresh Cream and Cowbelle single cream listed

name: Double cream
definition: cream of the highest pouring and whipping fat tier.
notes: Sainsbury's Extra Thick Double Fresh Cream, Waitrose double cream listed

name: Thickened cream
definition: cream with a thickener added to a whipping fat tier so that it holds its shape when whipped.
notes: Bulla Thickened Cream listed under cooking and thickened cream

name: Soured cream
definition: cream cultured to a sour, thick finish.
notes: Sainsbury's Soured Cream and Cowbelle Soured Cream listed; Emborg sour cream

name: Goat's milk
notes: Meyenberg goat milk ultra pasteurized half gallon, ingredients goat milk and vitamin D3

name: Crème fraîche
definition: thick cultured cream with a mild sour taste.
notes: Président crème fraîche épaisse entière 30% MG sold as its own product

name: Ghee
definition: clarified butter cooked until its milk solids brown, with a nutty flavour and long shelf life.
notes: Organic Valley ghee described as clarified butter cooked to nutty, caramel flavour; page ties ghee to clarified butter

name: Spreadable butter blend
definition: spread of butter blended with vegetable oil; a spread that contains butter.
notes: Lurpak spreadable: butter 64% plus rapeseed oil

name: Butter
definition: churned milk fat and water, salted or unsalted.
notes: Kerrygold Pure Irish Salted and Unsalted Butter listed as products

name: Whole milk powder
notes: Kerrygold Full Cream Milk Powder listed under Milk

name: Kefir
definition: milk fermented with kefir culture (grains), a tart drinkable fermented milk.
notes: Lifeway organic lowfat plain kefir, tart cultured milk drink with live cultures

name: Cheddar
definition: semi-hard pressed cheese made by cheddaring the curd, mild to vintage by age.
notes: Kerrygold sells Cheddar, Mature, Extra Mature, Vintage, Red Cheddar

name: Gouda
definition: semi-hard pressed round cheese of Dutch type, young to aged.

name: Emmental
definition: semi-hard Alpine cooked-pressed cheese with large holes.
